title: nofetch Configuration
description: Schema for the nofetch system fetcher configuration files

art.description: Configuration for the fetch art display.

colors.description: The color applied to the ASCII art.

modules.description: The sequence of modules to display in the fetch output.

type.description: The type of component to render.

label.description: Custom text label for the component.

value.description: Static text or template (e.g., '└{}┘') for custom types.

format.description: Format string for the output using tokens like {1}, {2}, etc.

width.description: Determines if a repeated symbol should fill the entire line or just fit the content.

repeat.description: The symbol to repeat inside the {} placeholder of the value string.

color.description: The color applied to the label and/or custom value.

icon.description: A Nerd Font icon character to display at the start of the row.

symbol.description: Determines the shape used when type is 'colors'.

thresholds.description: Defines the [medium, max] thresholds for the ':dynamic' color token. Example: [60, 80]
